ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: The figure below is a topographic profile and climate statistical chart along a certain meridian within China's territory. Read the figure and answer: <image1> In the figure, what is the approximate elevation of the place with the most precipitation?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: In the figure, the horizontal axis indicates the position from south to north along a certain meridian, with “Equator” marked in the middle; on the left side there is an annual precipitation scale, on the right side there is an elevation scale, and the solid line indicates the topographic profile. The annual precipitation curve in the figure reaches its highest point south of the Equator, near the position marked “C”. Then reason: From the point of highest precipitation, correspond downward to the solid-line topographic profile at the same horizontal position; reading the terrain height there from the right-side elevation axis, it is approximately between 1000 m and 2000 m, close to 1500 m. Therefore, the elevation of the place with the most precipitation is approximately 1500 m.

raw_record.question_text:

method.method_draft: 先观察图像：图中有南—赤道—北方向的水平轴，左侧有年降水量刻度，右侧有海拔刻度，实线表示地形剖面。找到年降水量曲线的最高处；从该最高处作垂线对应到同一水平位置的实线地形剖面；再用右侧海拔轴估读该点高度，约为1500 m。
method.CoT_raw: 先描述图像：图中横轴表示沿某经线由南到北的位置，中间标有“赤道”；左侧有年降水量刻度，右侧有海拔刻度，实线表示地形剖面。图中的年降水量曲线在赤道以南、接近标注“丙”的位置达到最高。再推理：从降水量最高点向下对应到同一水平位置的实线地形剖面，该处地形高度读右侧海拔轴，约在1000 m与2000 m之间，接近1500 m。因此，降水最多地点的海拔约为1500 m。
method.CoT_answer_check_final: 先描述图像：图中横轴表示沿某经线由南到北的位置，中间标有“赤道”；左侧有年降水量刻度，右侧有海拔刻度，实线表示地形剖面。图中的年降水量曲线在赤道以南、接近标注“丙”的位置达到最高。再推理：从降水量最高点向下对应到同一水平位置的实线地形剖面，该处地形高度读右侧海拔轴，约在1000 m与2000 m之间，接近1500 m。因此，降水最多地点的海拔约为1500 m。
method.CoT_qualify_0: 该推理链整体符合题意、标准答案和方法草案。它先描述图像要素，再依据降水量曲线最高点对应地形剖面估读海拔，顺序满足“先描述图像，再推理”。最终答案为约1500 m，与标准答案一致。小幅可改进处：可明确说明图中降水量曲线是哪一种线型/哪条曲线，以减少“年降水量曲线”与其他气候曲线混淆的可能；“向下对应”表述可改为“沿同一水平位置对应到地形剖面”，因为剖面图中只是同一横坐标对应，不一定严格是向下。
method.CoT_final: 先描述图像：图中横轴表示沿某经线由南到北的位置，中间标有“赤道”；左侧有年降水量刻度，右侧有海拔刻度，实线表示地形剖面。图中的年降水量曲线在赤道以南、接近标注“丙”的位置达到最高。再推理：从降水量最高点向下对应到同一水平位置的实线地形剖面，该处地形高度读右侧海拔轴，约在1000 m与2000 m之间，接近1500 m。因此，降水最多地点的海拔约为1500 m。

planner_metadata.image_role: Read the plotted annual precipitation curve against the left precipitation axis, find its highest point in the diagram, note its horizontal position along the south–north transect, then read the elevation of the solid terrain-profile line at that same x-position from the right-hand altitude axis. The relevant solid profile height is about midway between 1000 m and 2000 m, near 1500 m.
planner_metadata.text_role: Use the question wording “降水最多的地点，其海拔” to determine that the target is not the maximum rainfall value itself but the elevation at the location where rainfall is greatest.
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: Use the rule for composite geographic profiles: all curves share the same horizontal distance/position axis, while different vertical axes give different variables. The altitude must be read from the terrain profile, not from the precipitation scale.
